Starting the Feed & Discovery Audit for bainluck.com. I'll systematically evaluate the home feed, category pages, navigation, and mobile experience, capturing screenshots along the way.

I have completed the comprehensive Feed & Discovery Audit for bainluck.com. 

The audit revealed that while the site has an excellent mobile experience and a strong core concept (translating complex odds into simple probabilities), there are several critical data quality issues. Most notably, I found FIFA World Cup matches incorrectly labeled as baseball, stale markets from past months still being featured as "trending", and significant bugs in the NHL and NBA championship grids.

The complete findings, including the health score and specific actionable recommendations for improving the experience for first-time users, are detailed in the attached report. I have also attached all the requested screenshots, including those highlighting the critical failures.
